title: Research Software Developer
description_html:
About the role

A research group in the Faculty of Science needs a developer for its data tools.

What you'll do

  • Maintain Python packages used by three research labs
  • Write REST APIs for lab instruments
  • Teaching short workshops for graduate students

What you bring

  • Python and Git
  • Linux
  • A PhD or Master's degree in a scientific field

Nice to have

  • Docker

Pay and benefits

  • Salary: $72,000–$80,000 CAD per year
  • Four weeks of vacation and a yearly learning budget
